text_block_list.text: (Uwooooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa takes 1st place!!
She backed up her words! She has defeated the strongest Condor!

"—On this day,
Nakayama Festa overcame a major hurdle."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...It's not a dream.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's not a dream, it's not a dream! It's not a dream!!
Nakayama Festa could even surpass
El Condor Pasa's record—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Give me your applause.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Wherever this sky stretches, I can run anywhere.
That is a dream every Umamusume envisions at least once.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However, there must have been plenty of people
who looked away, dismissing it as nothing more than a child's dream.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Among them, one brave Umamusume
gave the crowd a glimpse of pure romance.

text_block_list.name: Past Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's El Condor Pasa,
just a little more... she's overtaken at the very last moment!"

text_block_list.name: Past Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"This is the wall of the world!
El Condor Pasa, a heartbreaking second place—!"

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! El Condor Pasa was so close!
For a second in the middle there, I thought she had it won!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's gotten me really excited for next year's Arc!
I mean, we're just a hair away from taking on the world!”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That romantic allure inspired people.
It stirred up excitement and created momentum.

text_block_list.name: Past Commentary
text_block_list.text: "And Manhattan Cafe crosses the finish line from behind! Once again, Japan's dream has been deferred!"

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer
text_block_list.text:
"Her positioning was good, though...
Keep this momentum up! Next time, an Umamusume like El Condor Pasa will—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yet no matter how far we chase that romantic dream,
no matter how long—

text_block_list.name: Past Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"‘She chases hard, but falls just short!
Japan's hero has narrowly missed out
on conquering the world!’"

text_block_list.name: Salaryman A
text_block_list.text:
...Failed again, huh...
And here I thought this would be the time...

text_block_list.name: Salaryman B
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, El Condor Pasa getting 2nd place was a massive achievement for Japan.
Come on, Chief, let's head home.

text_block_list.name: Salaryman A
text_block_list.text:
…………If only we could've taken it
back when El Condor Pasa ran.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whenever their dreams slipped further away, people looked down.
They looked back, daunted by the loftiness of those ideals.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Somewhere along the line, that very romance turned into a massive wall.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yet what meaning is there in a world devoid of romance?! What joy can be found in a future without dreams?!
(WOOOOOAAAH!! NAKAYAMAAA!!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: How's that, look at today's frenzy! Dream big, play the fool! Radiate the highest caliber of brilliance!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Send your cheers!! Send your blessings!!
We are the ones who carve our freedom!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*... *hahaha*...
Aaah...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's rough...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, you come too. Here—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The sky is beautiful.

I look up at the sky beside Nakayama Festa.
The view, which should have been ordinary,
looked like a special work of art—just for today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I wonder if the sky over there is just as pretty as this.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure it'll look exceptionally beautiful.
Yeah, I'm sure it'll look exceptionally beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha... Well, I'm looking forward to that.
choice_data_list: Still, looking up at the sky and smiling is the victor's privilege.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha.
True enough. No one ever looks up and remembers
what the sky looked like after a loss, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: By the way, could you keep lending me your shoulder like this?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... it's hard to put any power in.
Feels like my legs are totally outta fuel.

Lending a shoulder to Nakayama Festa,
I help her slowly stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... whew.
So this is what the world stage is made of, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm barely clinging to the edge of victory as it is. How the hell am I gonna turn that around in just one year?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I will.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Just as I expected, you've surpassed me."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I took my first step toward a place
no one has ever reached.
I know I can bring victory to those I cherish."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Never crying over half a length,
never harboring the sorrow of a head's defeat!!
Leaving everything behind in your dust, you—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—...Ngh.
H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...! W-Why...?
This isn't... a place to cry...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You bet your dream on me too.
You made that choice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's why you ran with all your might,
and let me surpass
the real, serious you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've firmly received the ticket
to the place you wanted to go.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, El.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All you did was reach out a hand.
You simply showed me what the world is like.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Surpassing you is just the beginning anyway, right?
The final stop on this ticket... is the top of the world!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Of course!
I will continue to train you strictly from now on!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Please win in El's place...!
Make sure you do it!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Leave it to me, leave it to me. I'll bring home a massive win.
Now, the future has opened up—
